description.p: A simple, fast Markdown viewer. Open a .md file and read it in a clean window that follows the system light or dark style.

ul.li: Tables, task lists and syntax-highlighted code
Reloads automatically when the file is saved
Opens links in your default browser

description.p: Choose the page width and the light or dark style from the main menu. Wide tables and code blocks grow wider instead of scrolling sideways, and your settings and window size are remembered.
Zoom in and out with Ctrl and the mouse wheel.
